name: Goya / Black Paintings
summary: Goya's dark late period as an interface: near-black grounds, bone-white highlights, somber earth pigments, blood-red accents, and figures emerging from shadow under etched crosshatch.
whenToUse: When the user asks for Goya, the Black Paintings, Los Caprichos, a chiaroscuro or old-master look, dark-academia fine-art styling, etching/aquatint texture, somber museum or gallery presentation, or a dramatic near-black interface with bone and earth tones.

effects.vignette: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, transparent 0%, transparent 26%, rgba(13,11,9,.55) 62%, rgba(0,0,0,.94) 100%)

rules: Light is the layout: every surface is lit from one direction, a single bone #e8dcc8 highlight climbs out of a near-black ground #0d0b09, and everything the light does not reach falls to #2a2a28 or darker — no evenly lit cards, no ambient fill.

Pigment, not neon: the palette is bone #e8dcc8, ochre #a56a2e, sienna #7a3b1e, blood #6e1414, and charcoal #2a2a28 on the void; saturation stays low, contrast stays extreme, and pure white or pure black never sits next to a mid-tone.
Red is a wound, not a brand: blood #6e1414 is reserved for the single most consequential action or the one true alert on a screen, never for decoration, secondary buttons, or hover tints.
Etched edges: borders are 1px hairlines in #2a2a28 or #8a7a63, corners stay at 2px, and texture arrives through crosshatch rules and aquatint grain rather than rounded cards, glow, or glass.

Set display type in Playfair Display 700–900 at 32px and up with tight 0.02em tracking and a slight negative letter-spacing at large sizes; body is Playfair 400 or Cormorant 400 at 17–19px/1.6, and IBM Plex Mono carries labels, dates, catalogue numbers, and captions in uppercase with 0.14em tracking.
Motion is slow and ominous: 480–2400ms, one-way easing that settles without bounce, opacity and luminance changes instead of slides, and nothing that loops faster than 12 seconds or flickers.

Frame like a plate: give content a generous dark margin, a single hairline rule under the masthead, and a small mono caption in the lower left that names the state — the composition should feel printed and mounted rather than scrolled.
Stay evocation-only: no Goya painting, etching, or detail is cropped, traced, recoloured, or shipped as a background image — the mood comes from palette, light behaviour, and drawn crosshatch.

componentRecipes.panel: background: #16120e; border: 1px solid #2a2a28; border-radius: 2px; padding: 28px; color: #e8dcc8; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,220,200,.05), 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.72); — the panel is a lit object in a dark room: add a top-left falloff with a pseudo-element using radial-gradient(120% 100% at 0% 0%, rgba(232,220,200,.055), transparent 58%) and let the lower right stay near-black; headings are Playfair Display 700 26px with a 1px #8a7a63 rule 12px beneath, and a card that holds an alert may take border-left: 3px solid #6e1414 with no other colour change.
componentRecipes.button: font: 700 15px/1 'Playfair Display', 'Cormorant', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 2px; background: #a56a2e; color: #0d0b09; border: 1px solid #c08a48; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,220,200,.22), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55); transition: background-color 480ms cubic-bezier(.22,.08,.18,1), box-shadow 480ms cubic-bezier(.22,.08,.18,1), color 480ms linear; :hover { background: #c08a48; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,220,200,.28), 0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.6); } :active { background: #7a4a1c; } :focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #e8dcc8; outline-offset: 3px; } — primary reads as candlelight on ochre; the destructive variant is #6e1414 with a #f3ecdf label and appears once per view at most; secondary is transparent with a 1px #8a7a63 border and bone text.
componentRecipes.input: font: 400 17px/1.6 'Playfair Display', 'Cormorant', Georgia, serif; color: #e8dcc8; background: #0d0b09; border: 1px solid #2a2a28; border-radius: 2px; padding: 13px 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.8); :placeholder { color: #8a7a63; font-style: italic; } :focus { border-color: #a56a2e; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 0 0 1px #a56a2e; outline: none; } — label above in 11px IBM Plex Mono uppercase, letter-spacing 0.14em, colour #8a7a63; invalid inputs take border-color #8f2222 plus a 14px italic sentence beneath in #b9a98f that states what is wrong, so the error never depends on the red line alone.
componentRecipes.statusbar: height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; padding: 0 28px; background: #0d0b09; border-top: 1px solid #2a2a28; font: 500 11px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #8a7a63; left side is a single engraved line of state — plate number, state, timestamp — separated by 1px #2a2a28 rules rather than dots; the right side holds one quiet text action in bone #e8dcc8; the active entry brightens to #e8dcc8 over 1200ms, and any failure word alone turns #8f2222 with a 1px #6e1414 underline.
componentRecipes.menu: a vertical catalogue, no bullets, 2px gap on a #0d0b09 ground: item { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 17px/1.4 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; color: #b9a98f; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a28; } selected row turns #e8dcc8 with a 3px #6e1414 bar on its left edge and a mono index at the right; hover lightens the text to #e8dcc8 over 480ms and draws a 1px #8a7a63 rule under the label; group headers are 11px IBM Plex Mono uppercase, letter-spacing 0.18em, #8a7a63, with a full-width hairline above.
componentRecipes.toggle: engraved plate switch, 64px x 34px: track { background: #0d0b09; border: 1px solid #2a2a28; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.85); } knob is a 26px square with 1px #8a7a63 border and 2px radius, #2a2a28 when off and #a56a2e when on, translating 30px over 1200ms cubic-bezier(.22,.08,.18,1); when off a faint crosshatch fills the knob, when on the knob takes a bone #e8dcc8 top highlight so it reads as catching light; the state is also written out to the right in 11px Plex Mono uppercase ('Off'/'On', #8a7a63 / #e8dcc8).

copywriting.voice: A museum wall label crossed with a plate inscription: grave, exact, and a little theatrical. Copy names what is seen and what it costs ('The register is closed. No names were taken.') in the present tense, prefers nouns to adjectives, and lets one short sentence carry the weight where a paragraph would dissipate it. Never cheerful, never chatty, never scolding — the reader is a witness, not a customer.

case.headers: Title Case for section heads; ALL CAPS only for 1–3 word plate labels
case.commands: sentence case imperative ('Enter the name', 'Close the register')

avoid: exclamation marks and uplift ('Great job!', 'You're all set!')
cute or forgiving error copy ('Oops', 'Uh-oh', 'No worries')
quoting Goya's capricho captions or reproducing any work's title as UI copy
long all-caps sentences; all-caps is for labels of three words or fewer

do: Light every screen from one source: a bone highlight that fades into charcoal and void, so the eye is led to the single most important element first.
Keep the ground at #0d0b09 and surfaces at #16120e, and let bone #e8dcc8 text carry the reading load at 17–19px with 1.6 line-height.
Reserve blood #6e1414 for one consequential action or one true alert per view, and treat ochre #a56a2e as the working primary.
Draw texture with 1px crosshatch rules, 45°/135° repeating-linear-gradients at low alpha, and aquatint grain — never with bitmap artwork or a photographic background.
Mount content like a plate: generous dark margins, a hairline rule under the masthead, and a small Plex Mono caption that states place, state, and date.
Let type do the drama — Playfair Display at 700–900 for display, italic Cormorant for asides, Plex Mono uppercase for catalogue data — and keep body copy quiet.
Move slowly: 480–1200ms luminance and opacity transitions that settle in one direction, with no bounce and no looping shimmer.
dont: No Goya artwork, etching, or detail — no crops, traces, recolours, or AI pastiche — as imagery, texture, or hero background; evocation comes from palette, light, and drawn hatching only.
No pure white #ffffff on pure black #000000 as a text pair; bone on void is the contract, and the vignette may reach black only at the frame edge.
No second red, no neon, no gradient mesh, no glassmorphism, no backdrop-blur, and no glow stronger than the single 0 0 48px rgba(232,220,200,.05) halo.
No rounded 12–24px cards, no pill buttons, no soft ambient drop shadows, and no 2px+ decorative strokes — 1px hairlines and 2px radii are the whole vocabulary.
No cheerful microcopy, no confetti, no success emoji, and no green brighter than #6b7f5e; celebration is off-mode.
No fast motion: no 120ms hovers, no spring overshoot, no infinite spinners, and no flicker that could be mistaken for a CRT effect.
accessibility: Bone #e8dcc8 on #0d0b09 clears 13:1 and #8a7a63 on #0d0b09 clears about 4.6:1 — hold muted text at 14px or larger, and never dim body copy below #b9a98f.
Blood #6e1414 and ochre #a56a2e are for fills, rules, and large bold labels only; text on top of them is bone #e8dcc8 and must be checked against the fill, not the ground.

The heavy vignette must never sit over text or focus rings — apply it to the page frame at 26% and beyond so the readable field stays clear, and keep a visible 1px bone focus outline with 3px offset on every focusable element.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion: replace the 480–2400ms luminance transitions with instant state changes and keep the crosshatch and vignette static, since neither carries meaning on its own.
Never signal state with pigment alone — pair every red rule, ochre fill, and crosshatch change with a word in Plex Mono ('Failed', 'Open', 'Closed') so colour is confirmation rather than the message.
signatureElement: A chiaroscuro figure emerging from a near-black ground: one bone-lit focal shape cut by etched crosshatch, with the heavy vignette closing the frame around it

attribution.name: Francisco Goya — late works (Black Paintings, 1819–1823; Los Caprichos, 1799) — aesthetic reference
attribution.license: public domain works — evocation only, no artworks reproduced
attribution.note: Palette, light behaviour, and etching texture are inspired by the late paintings and aquatints; no painting, etching, detail, or caption is reproduced or traced.

attribution.name: Earth palette (void #0d0b09, bone #e8dcc8, ochre #a56a2e, sienna #7a3b1e, blood #6e1414, charcoal #2a2a28) — derived by eye from Goya's late works, not sampled from any image file

prose.overview: This mode stages the interface as a late Goya canvas: a near-black ground, one bone-lit focal point, somber earth pigments, and the whole frame closing into shadow at the edges. It is dramatic but austere — the drama comes from where the light falls, not from ornament, so a page reads as a single lit subject in a dark room. Etching shows up as texture rather than imagery: 1px crosshatch rules, aquatint grain, hairline plate borders, and mono captions that behave like inscriptions. It should feel mounted and witnessed, never decorated, and never nostalgic for a retro screen.
prose.colors: The void #0d0b09 is the ground and #16120e is the only surface that lifts off it; charcoal #2a2a28 draws every hairline and every unlit plane. Bone #e8dcc8 carries text and highlight, dimming to #b9a98f for secondary copy and #8a7a63 for labels and captions. Ochre #a56a2e is the working primary — candlelight on a warm earth — with sienna #7a3b1e for pressed and secondary states and blood #6e1414 held back for the one consequential action or true alert on a screen. Saturation stays low and value contrast stays extreme: the system reads as pigment mixed with lead white and bone black, so no hue is allowed to glow, and the earthRamps give each pigment a light/base/dark triad for hover, rest, and press.
prose.typography: Playfair Display leads at 700–900 for display, with its high-contrast didone stress supplying the engraved feel; Cormorant and Cormorant Garamond are the softer fallbacks, and Georgia is the last resort before a generic serif. Headings run 32px and up with 1.05–1.2 line-height and slightly negative tracking at the largest sizes, body copy sits at 17–19px/1.6 in Playfair 400 or Cormorant 400, and italic is the register for asides, epigraphs, and placeholders. IBM Plex Mono is the inscription voice: 11–12px uppercase with 0.14–0.18em tracking for plate numbers, dates, states, and captions, never for paragraphs. Typography does the dramatic work here, so a neutral grotesque or a rounded sans would collapse the whole mode.
prose.layout: Layout is a mounted plate: a 4px-derived scale of 4/8/16/28/48px, a 12-column grid at 28px gutters, and margins wide enough that the dark ground always frames the content. The reading column rarely exceeds 68 characters, because long light-on-dark lines smear; the composition is built around one focal block per view, positioned in the upper-left light and allowed to fall off toward the lower right. Rules are 1px hairlines, never boxes within boxes, and captions sit at the lower left like an inscription on a print. On narrow screens the plate keeps its margins and stacks vertically, preserving the masthead rule, the single focal block, and the caption order rather than collapsing into an edge-to-edge app shell.
prose.elevation: There is no drop-shadow depth in the ordinary sense — light is the elevation model. A lit surface sits at #16120e with an inset bone highlight along its top edge (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,220,200,.05)) and a deep 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.72) falloff beneath it, so it appears to rise out of the void rather than float above a page. The single permitted glow is a 0 0 48px rgba(232,220,200,.05) halo around a focal element, and the page-level vignette darkens from 26% outward to near-black at the frame edge. Nothing is blurred, frosted, or glassy; recessed wells use inset shadow, and a modal is simply a plate on a darker ground with its own hairline border.
prose.shapes: Geometry is severe and printed: 2px radii at most, 1px hairline borders, and right angles everywhere else, because the mode's softness belongs to paint handling rather than to corners. Texture replaces curvature — 45° and 135° crosshatch at 3–6% alpha, aquatint grain in flat fills, and occasional drypoint scratches drawn as single 1px lines that stop short of the edge. Icons are engraved marks built from hairlines and hatching, silhouetted against the ground, never filled with gradients or outlined at 3px cartoon weight. Circles are rare and deliberate: a candle flame, an eye, a seal — if a shape is round it is because the subject is round, not because the component is friendly.
prose.components: Panels are near-black plates with a 1px charcoal border, 2px radius, a faint top-left light falloff, and a deep shadow beneath; alert panels may take a single 3px blood left edge. Buttons are ochre uppercase Playfair labels on a 2px-radius block whose hover brightens toward #c08a48 and whose press drops to #7a4a1c, with a transparent secondary that keeps a #8a7a63 hairline and bone text. Inputs are sunken wells at #0d0b09 with an inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.8), italic bone placeholders, and an ochre hairline on focus. Toggles are engraved switches whose square knob turns from charcoal to ochre, the status bar is an inscription strip of mono state separated by hairline rules, and menus are catalogue lists where the selected row gains a blood left bar and a mono index.
prose.dosDonts: Do light from one source, do keep the ground near-black and the text bone, do let 1px hairlines and crosshatch carry texture, do reserve blood red for the single consequential moment, and do keep motion slow enough to feel grave. Don't reproduce or trace any Goya work, don't pair pure white with pure black, don't round corners or add pill buttons, don't chase brightness with neon or glow, and don't undercut the mood with cheerful microcopy or fast springy animation.
